title: Background task transfers
description: Prove transfer subprocess ownership, copy semantics and isolated authenticated dispatch.

transfer-owner.intent: SSH/SCP/rsync staging processes belong to the existing background child. Verify marker-last ordering, failed-copy stop, real rsync bytes/exclusions, inherited cancellation and an untimed transfer over ten virtual minutes; no network hosts or farm slots.

dispatch-smoke.intent: Authenticated create reaches write-task, prepare and dispatch, then cancels, archives and verifies the owned fixture returned to main. Supply immutable FARMSLOT_CLI, fresh FARMSLOT_SAFE_IDLE_PROOF_OUT and TMPDIR on an eligible volume; normal storage floor remains unchanged.
